title: MACOM Honored by Massachusetts Legislators

LOWELL, Mass., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MACOM Technology Solutions Inc. (“MACOM”), a leading supplier of semiconductor products, today announced that it has received a 2026 Manufacturer of the Year Award from the Massachusetts Legislative Manufacturing Caucus. The award recognizes outstanding leadership in manufacturing and honors Massachusetts companies that contribute to growth and innovation across the Commonwealth. MACOM received the award during the 11th Annual Manufacturing Awards Ceremony at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts.


MACOM designs and manufactures high-performance semiconductor products for industrial and defense, telecommunications and data center applications. MACOM conducts research and development and operates a semiconductor wafer fabrication facility in Lowell, Massachusetts. The company continues to invest in and modernize its Massachusetts operations, support workforce growth and advance domestic semiconductor manufacturing.


“We are delighted to receive this recognition from the Massachusetts Legislative Manufacturing Caucus,” said Stephen G. Daly, President and Chief Executive Officer, MACOM. “This award reflects the commitment of our talented employees and our continued focus on manufacturing innovation in Massachusetts.”


“We are pleased to recognize MACOM as a 2026 Manufacturer of the Year. MACOM is an important employer in Lowell and an example of the advanced manufacturing and technology capabilities we have in Massachusetts, and I was honored to nominate,” said Senator Vanna Howard. “The company’s continued investment in its operations and workforce strengthens our local economy and creates opportunities for people in our community who exemplify what it means to ‘Make it in Massachusetts.’”


**About the Massachusetts Legislative Manufacturing Caucus** The Massachusetts Legislative Manufacturing Caucus brings together legislators from across the Commonwealth to support manufacturing workforce training, innovation, access to resources and apprenticeship opportunities in key manufacturing sectors.


**About MACOM** MACOM designs and manufactures semiconductor products for telecommunications, industrial and defense and data center applications. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM has design centers and sales offices throughout North America, Europe and Asia. MACOM is certified to the ISO9001 international quality standard and ISO14001 environmental management standard.
